# syncwheel

> Deterministic Git maintenance for PR stacks, draft stacks, integration branches, pinned deployment
> channels, and multi-agent repositories — several pull requests built and published from one
> checkout, without a worktree per branch.

Journal mode is the plan-first single-branch alternative for safe allowlisted
snapshots, exact-lease publication, and an optional Linux systemd user timer.

Delivery manifest version 3 adds channels: an exact base plus selected stack
revisions pinned with base and dependency provenance into ordered, rebuildable
branches. Every mutation is preview-first and digest-bound; durable operations
and observation-only reconciliation make uncertain outcomes recoverable.
Channel-local resolution snapshots preserve source stacks, and publication uses
an exact lease. Channel publication is not an environment deployment.

## Install Commands

```bash
uv tool install "git+https://github.com/NestDevLab/syncwheel"
syncwheel self status
agentwheel install github:NestDevLab/syncwheel --adapter codex --local --skill syncwheel
```
